title: Dube, Lester, Reich (2016), Minimum Wage Shocks, Employment Flows, and Labor Market Frictions, JLE 34(3)
summary: 州界断点:最低工资对employment flows有明显负效应但对stocks没有;affected workers的separations与accessions下降(尤其低tenure);分离弹性约0.23;与endogenous separations搜寻模型一致——turnover下降是monopsony/摩擦的直接指纹。

bindings.note: 离职/流量下降的直接指纹
